content: {"like":["New characters played by Meghan Gallagher did well","Robert Clohessy as Flaherty did well","The pairing of Meghan Gallagher and Robert Clohessy was a good match","The scene with Buntz, Washington, Larue, Jablonski, Davenport, and Furillo standing side by side at the hospital was moving","Jon Cyphers as Chief Daniels provided comedic relief with his hyper, hypocritical, political rants","Jon Cyphers' facial expressions and pompous demeanor were priceless","The final season was still good TV, especially for the 80s","The end of the series was appropriate and in time"],"dislike":[]}
